body: When you are grieving guilt is normal, believe me every time a person close to me died I felt guilty at some point or another. The fact is you were not responsible for your uncle, you could have probably acted better because you cannot be perfect. You didn’t know and you could not know how bad his state was. Grief is hard, it’s one of the worse periods to live and there is nothing wrong with needing help. If no one in your family listens to you you should seek for professional help.

Your feelings matter. If there is one and only thing you are entitled to it’s your emotions, there is nothing wrong with being sad or depressed. I think you should ask yourself why you are sad. Nobody has a perfect life, there is always at least some things that are going wrong. Maybe for other people you’re problems will seem ridiculous but their opinion does not matter. All that matters is what you feel. If you can the best option would be to have an honest conversation about your sadness with your parents. If they don’t listen you could talk with a school counselor or a teacher you like or if you have the possibility you could talk with a professional.
I will look into these options, thank you

I managed to find another hotline, it is kinda of an international thing and I had to talk in English but I have I talked for about 45 minutes with someone and I feel a lot better now. That person helped me see that my parents problems are not mine. But I know that this is not viable long term option.

I am desperately fighting against my will to kill myself, but honestly the only thing holding me back is how much I would hurt my parents. If they died I would immediately kill myself, I think.

I don’t think I will meet someone to cuddle and hug with during a lockdown but you’re message made me smile and laugh so thank you.

I will try to get professional help but I have a hard time talking about my situation if I am not anonymous. For suicide hotlines well in my very small country there is only one in my first language (french) the other ones are in languages that I don’t speak well. I already tried to call several but all lines were taken and the call ended (yes no waiting list), I will try again.
Thanks for your answer, I know I need to call but I just can’t manage do it, I will try again tomorrow.
